Why every day is the only rule

Creatine does not work like caffeine. There is no same day hit. It builds up in your muscle and brain tissue with daily use, and your stores are full at around 4 weeks.*

Take it daily and it stays topped up, supporting strength, recovery and how you age.* Skip days and the level drops back.

So the habit is the product. You have already made that part automatic, which is the hard bit.

Any time of day, with or without food. Every day including rest days. No loading phase.
